Subject: Redwood Private VPC — competitive follow-up & next tests

Hi Alice / Bob,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciated the context on your compliance needs and the high-level networking constraints for the air-gapped pilot.

Quick recap & proposed next steps:

- Competitive notes: you mentioned evaluating both the major hyperscaler offering and two inference APIs. Key differentiators for us based on the conversation:
  - Private control plane with customer-managed VPC and optional on-prem package (vs hyperscalers' limited control plane options)
  - Stronger audit logs/KMS integrations that map to your SOC2/PHI needs
  - Intelligent routing/fallbacks to preserve availability without exposing data outside your VPC

- Proposed next tests:
  1) Networking validation: we'll share a network topology diagram and a checklist for outbound/inbound rules for the control plane connector (attaching network_topology.png). We can run a short connectivity smoke test with your infra team.
  2) Air-gap feasibility: run a gated offline deploy exercise with a minimal model and container image so you can validate package signing and install procedures.
  3) Performance parity: we'll spin up a small Dedicated pool for a week to compare tail latency and token cost against the hyperscaler baseline you provided.

Attachments: redwood_vs_hyperscalers_comparison.pdf, network_topology.png

Would Thursday 10–11am PT work for the networking sync with your infra/security folks? If not, propose two slots and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Alice — quick answers:

- Control plane: The default hosted control plane resides in Redwood's managed environment, however for Private deployments we offer a customer-managed control plane option. In the customer-managed variant, control-plane endpoints are deployed into your VPC and communicate over private links; Redwood does not route model payloads through public internet in that setup.

- Air-gapped bundle: yes — we produce a signed offline bundle containing the runtime, model artefacts (if requested), and an install script. Bundles include SHA256 checksums and are signed with our release key; we can also work with your SSO/KMS for key verification.

I'll bring a more detailed design doc to the call and share the bundle checklist beforehand.

—Marissa
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
